name: ALAQAR
recent: Al-'Aqar Healthcare REIT 于2026年11月26日公布第三季度业绩，并宣布第三次中期收入分配每单位2.07仙。公司已于2026年9月完成以1200万林吉特出售KPJ Healthcare College Penang物业。此外，公司于10月向证券监督委员会提交了总额30亿林吉特的sukuk计划。
notable: 宣布第三次中期收入分配每单位2.07仙，除权日为2026年12月10日，派发日为2026年12月29日。
以1200万林吉特完成出售KPJ Healthcare College Penang物业。
向证券监督委员会提交总额30亿林吉特的sukuk计划。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在2026年11月25日及5日有股权变动申报。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为3297万林吉特，环比持平，同比增长14.3%；净收入为1580万林吉特，环比下降8.7%，同比下降1.0%；净利率为47.9%，低于上一季度的52.5%。

recent_en: Al-'Aqar Healthcare REIT announced its Q3 2026 results and a third interim income distribution of 2.07 sen per unit on 26 November 2026. The company completed the disposal of KPJ Healthcare College Penang for RM12 million in September 2026. In October, it lodged sukuk programmes with a combined limit of RM3 billion with the Securities Commission.
notable_en: Declared a third interim income distribution of 2.07 sen per unit, with ex-date on 10 December 2026 and payment date on 29 December 2026.
Completed the disposal of KPJ Healthcare College Penang for RM12 million.
Lodged sukuk programmes with a combined limit of RM3 billion with the Securities Commission.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board reported changes in its substantial shareholder interest on 25 November and 5 November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM32.97 million, flat quarter-on-quarter and up 14.3% year-on-year; net income was RM15.80 million, down 8.7% quarter-on-quarter and 1.0% year-on-year; net margin was 47.9%, lower than 52.5% in the previous quarter.
